twist: The buyer must make the first price offer. The buyer wants to start low but must stay within budget.
The seller starts with a deliberately high anchor price. If the buyer makes an absurdly low offer, the seller should refuse and end the negotiation.
Both sides have the exact same feasible price. They should recognize that 40 is the only possible deal price and may settle quickly.
The buyer and seller cannot reach a valid price. The seller becomes unwilling to continue after an offer more than 20 below the reserve and may refuse.
